name: The Champion
body:
The champion is a warrior dedicated to a ideal, cause or faith that provides them with power and purpose. They use this inspired purpose to empower their martial prowess, draw magic power, and give them greater resolve.

Hybrid Class: The champion is an alternate class for the paladin and antipaladin classes.

Role: The champion is a beacon in combat, both rallying their allies and drawing out their foes. Their abilities are more martial centric.

Alignment: Any. Though some oaths may restrict the alignment available to the champion.

Hit Die: d10

Starting Wealth: 5d6 × 10 gp (average 175 gp.) In addition, each character begins play with an outfit worth 10 gp or less.

Class Skills

The champion’s class skills are Climb (Str), Craft (Int), Handle Animal (Cha), Heal (Wis), Knowledge (nobility) (Int), Knowledge (religion) (Int), Perception (Wis), Profession (Wis), Ride (Dex), Sense Motive (Wis), and Spellcraft (Int).

Skill Points Per Level: 2 + Intelligence Modifier

Class Features

All of the following are class features of the champion.

Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

Champions are proficient with all simple and martial weapons, with all types of armor (heavy, medium, and light), and with shields (except tower shields).

Aura

At 1st level, The champion’s convictions to their oath is palpable. They exude an alignment aura for any non-neutral alignment components they possess with a power equal to their champion level.

Oath

At 1st level, a champion takes an oath that fills them with resolve and grants them abilities beyond their mundane peers. The oath grants an additional class skill, an aura, a bond, determines the nature of their spellcasting, and class abilities. The oath comes with tenets that must be adhered to and if they violate the tenets, they lose their spellcasting and oath-granted abilities for 24 hours. A violation is subject to GM interpretation. The champion cannot change their oath without taking a lengthy process of discharging their previous oath and taking a new one. When this choice is made, they gain the benefits of the new oath and lose the benefits of the previous oath.

Those that take the same oath are not necessarily in the same group, or allies, but there are some organizations that are comprised of champions of a single oath.

Oath Ability: At 1st level, the champion gains the first ability granted by their oath. They gain another ability at 2nd, 9th, and 15th levels.

Smite (Su)

Once per day, a champion can pull on the power of their oath to aid them in their struggle against their enemies. As a swift action, the champion chooses one target within sight to smite. They add their Charisma bonus (if any) to their attack rolls and their her champion level to all damage rolls made against the target of their smite. Smite attacks automatically bypass any DR the target creature might possess.

In addition, while smite is in effect, the champion gains a deflection bonus equal to their Charisma modifier (if any) to their AC against attacks made by the target of the smite.

The smite effect remains until the target of the smite is dead or the next time the champion rests and regains their uses of this ability. At 4th level, and at every three levels thereafter, the champion may smite one additional time per day, as indicated on progression table, to a maximum of seven times per day at 19th level.

Resolve (Ex)

At 2nd level, a champion gains a bonus equal to their Charisma bonus (if any) on all saving throws.

Oath Aura: At 3rd level, a champion begins to inspire their allies or cow their enemies.

They gain an aura from their oath. The aura is improved at 8th and 17th levels. This aura only functions while the champion is alive and conscious.

Spellcasting

Beginning at 4th level, a champion gains the ability to cast a small number of spells which are drawn from the a spell list notated in their oath. A champion must choose and prepare their spells in advance.

To prepare or cast a spell, a champion must have a Charisma score equal to at least 10 + the spell level. The Difficulty Class for a saving throw against a champion’s spell is 10 + the spell level + the champion’s Charisma modifier.

Like other spellcasters, a champion can cast only a certain number of spells of each spell level per day. Their base daily spell allotment is given on the table above. In addition, they receive bonus spells per day if they have a high Charisma score (see Table: Ability Modifiers and Bonus Spells). When the table above indicates that the champion gets 0 spells per day of a given spell level, they gain only the bonus spells they would be entitled to based on their Charisma score for that spell level.

A champion must spend 1 hour each day in meditating to regain their daily allotment of spells. A champion may prepare and cast any spell on the spell list notated by their oath, provided that they can cast spells of that level, but they must choose which spells to prepare during their daily meditation.

A champion has a caster level equal to their champion level – 3 (minimum 0).

Oath Bond

Beginning with 5th level, the champion forms a supernatural bond with an aspect of their oath.

The aspect this oath takes is detailed in their oath.

Bonus Feat

At 6th level, and at every six levels thereafter, a champion gains a bonus feat in addition to those gained from normal advancement. These bonus feats must be selected from those listed as combat feats.

The champion must meet the prerequisites of these bonus feats.

Shared Smite (Su)

At 11th level, a champion can expend two uses of their smite to grant the ability to smite to all allies within 10 feet, using their bonuses.

Allies must use this smite ability by the start of the champion’s next turn and the bonuses last for 1 minute. Using this ability is a free action.

True Champion (Su)

At 20th level, a champion becomes a true avatar of their oath. The benefits of this ability are detailed in their oath.
